keyEvents.text: Goal! Hoffenheim 1, Schalke 04 0. Fisnik Asllani (Hoffenheim) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner.
Goal! Hoffenheim 2, Schalke 04 0. Tim Lemperle (Hoffenheim) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Fisnik Asllani.
First Half ends, Hoffenheim 2, Schalke 04 0.
Delay in match because of an injury Loris Karius (Schalke 04).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Schalke 04. Vitalie Becker replaces Robin Gosens because of an injury.
Substitution, Schalke 04. Kevin Müller replaces Loris Karius because of an injury.
Delay in match because of an injury Mertcan Ayhan (Schalke 04).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Hoffenheim. Adam Hlozek replaces Andrej Kramaric.
Substitution, Schalke 04. Junior Dina Ebimbe replaces Mertcan Ayhan because of an injury.
Substitution, Schalke 04. Junior Adamu replaces Satoshi Tanaka.
Delay in match (Hoffenheim).
Delay in match (Schalke 04).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Hwang Hee-Chan (Schalke 04) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Schalke 04. Edin Dzeko replaces Dejan Ljubicic.
Substitution, Hoffenheim. Bernardo replaces Mats Rots.
Substitution, Hoffenheim. Adam Daghim replaces Fisnik Asllani.
Goal! Hoffenheim 2, Schalke 04 1. Junior Adamu (Schalke 04) right footed shot from very close range to the centre of the goal following a corner.
Substitution, Hoffenheim. Max Moerstedt replaces Tim Lemperle.
Adil Aouchiche (Schalke 04) is shown the yellow card.
